title: should restore the conversation and show the RESTORED_NOTICE when chat_stream returns a pre-stream 409 session_owner_unavailable
verifies: a pre-stream 409 session_owner_unavailable triggers one resend, preserves the user message, and renders the recoverable RESTORED_NOTICE

title: should restore the conversation when a session_owner_unavailable error arrives mid-stream over SSE
verifies: a mid-stream SSE session_owner_unavailable event restores the conversation and renders the recoverable RESTORED_NOTICE

title: should not trigger restore for a non-owner generic server failure
verifies: a generic 500 failure renders a normal error and issues no restore resend and no recoverable notice

title: should surface an inline error when a tool-confirmation cannot be delivered (404)
verifies: a 404 on POST /ai/confirm/{sessionId} renders an inline 'could not be delivered' error instead of silently reading as accepted

title: should show an explicit could-not-be-restored message when the restore retry itself fails
verifies: a failed restore retry ends the turn with an explicit 'could not be restored' error block and no retry loop
